visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a tight close-up of a Rolex GMT-Master II watch featuring a rotatable ceramic bezel in red and blue. The watch face is black with luminous markers and a date window at the three o'clock position. (2) Cut to a male character in a light blue blazer standing against a navy blue wall adorned with the Rolex logo and an airplane icon. He pumps his fists enthusiastically with a joyful facial expression. (3) The scene shifts to the interior of a spacious exhibition hall where a full-sized silver airplane fuselage, branded with the Rolex logo, is parked on a platform. A massive curved screen in the background depicts snow-covered mountain peaks under a clear blue sky. (4) A series of rapid shots showcase various luxury watches, including a diamond-encrusted GMT-Master and a vintage model with a weathered bezel. The male character is seen talking and gesturing towards these items while accompanied by another man in a gray suit. (5) In a high-tech area, the man interacts with a digital display shaped like an airplane window, showcasing old printed advertisements featuring athletes. The environment is modern with sleek, minimalist shelving and soft, bright lighting. (6) A wide shot reveals a large illuminated Rolex sign positioned in front of a panoramic display of a city's night skyline, featuring a prominent skyscraper. The video concludes with the man sitting in a studio-like setting, speaking directly to the viewer.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a high-production vlog and promotional review of the 'GMT-Master Across Time' exhibition hosted by Rolex in Taipei. By combining energetic personal narration with detailed close-ups of luxury timepieces and large-scale exhibition displays, it aims to generate excitement and drive attendance to the limited-time event.
